text:
maria.chen: Heads-up — ran full onboarding smoke for raven-lite-xtq (4-bit) against our structured-func tests. Perf looks fine but ~2.3% of runs fail schema validation because model emits an extra metadata field 'tool_tag' inside the function output.

maria.chen: sample (raw streamed chunk):
```json
{"response":"ok","tool":{"name":"fetch_price","args":{"sku":"XYZ"},"tool_tag":"@fetch"}}
```

devin.patel: :thinking: tool_tag should be runtime wrapper metadata, never inside the JSON payload. Is this coming from the model or our postprocessor? Can you paste the raw token stream around the emission?

maria.chen: short token dump (indices truncated):
```
... 512 14 7 102 "tool_tag" 34 58 ...
```

sam.k: my hunch — kv-prefix batching + quant head alignment sometimes causes off-by-one token shifts, which can pull wrapper tokens into the model output. Repro when seq_len>2048.

maria.chen: confirmed — toggling batching off eliminates the tag. Also repros in CPU emulation of q4_0.

infra-bot: deploy 1768504200 -> canary applied to raven-lite-xtq

devin.patel: interim mitigation: strip keys that match /^tool_/ in the postprocess before schema validate. Longer term we should prevent emission at generation layer.

maria.chen: added a quick postprocess heuristic and re-ran: validation success went from 97.7% -> 99.9% on smoke set. Patch linked: s3://redwood-onboard/raven/v2a-q4/patches/tag-stripper-20260319.patch

sam.k: next steps: add unit test for structured-func outputs that fails on any extraneous meta keys; run kernel alignment experiments (phase-rotate heads and recompile kernels) and re-evaluate.

devin.patel: also add a canary that exercises high-throughput batching (seq_len span) with quantized mirrors. If we see regressions, fallback to non-batched or alternative kernel selector.

maria.chen: filing follow-ups: ticket #ML-4812 (unit test + kernel probe), #ML-4813 (canary config to exercise batch edgecases). Leaving logs and sample ids in the ticket. Thanks :eyes:
